name: Funnel Pills
description: Funnel stages as horizontal pills that shorten down the list, each with an icon, its count and its share of the first stage.

props.name: stages
props.type: { name: string; value: number; icon?: ReactNode; color?: string }[]
props.description: One row per stage, from the widest down. Each bar's length is its share of the first stage; colours step through the chart palette unless given.

props.name: format
props.description: Writes each stage's count. Defaults to grouped whole numbers.

props.name: formatShare
props.description: Writes shares and conversions, given as fractions. Defaults to whole percents.

props.name: summary
props.description: What the chart shows, for screen readers. Generated from the data when left out.

props.name: label
props.description: Small muted label at the top of the card.

props.name: delta
props.description: Change as a signed fraction, shown as a chip beside the value.

props.name: action
props.description: A control on the right of the header.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the card. Also accepts note, footer, invertDelta and every other prop of a div.
